findings:
🟠 [a2-status-not-asserted] MUST-FIX Spec item 3 requires asserting the resumed run's final status explicitly (converged/terminal and not `blocked`), but the engine stage still ends `blocked` (reason: controller_work_order_terminalize / "controller transcript audit blocks terminal") and the suite only asserts four specific reason substrings are absent, then logs the status to stderr as a "KNOWN GAP". The original defect ("hides a blocked resume") is therefore still present under a different reason. Smallest remediation: inject the terminalize/transcript-audit dependency the way `hooks/tests/lib/final-panel-seat-xproc-driver.js` does to drive its resume to `converged`, then add `assert_contains "$C_STATUS_LINE" "c_status=converged"` (or the real terminal status) and `assert_not_contains "$C_STATUS_LINE" "blocked"`. If that block is a product defect, the spec says stop and report path:line instead of landing a suite that tolerates it.
🔵 [a2-dup-cleanup-key] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `repairLineageCleanupTransaction` is defined twice in the engine options object (identical bodies, duplicate object-literal key; later wins, no behavioral effect, and `check-js-syntax.js` cannot see inside the heredoc). Delete one copy when fixing the above; not blocking on its own.
🔵 [a2-gate-scope] CUT/FOLLOW-UP The gate only recognizes `finalize_test` at line start on a non-comment line, so a suite calling it via a trap or inside a helper would be a false positive, and one calling it unconditionally before later assertions would be a false negative. Acceptable for the stated "smallest check"; the frozen 18-entry allowlist plus the stale-entry assertion are the right shape. Excluded as hardening beyond the spec.
